mechanism: Turmeric (curcumin) may inhibit CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, potentially increasing phenobarbital metabolism unpredictably, while phenobarbital induces CYP3A4 which may reduce turmeric's bioavailability and efficacy.
action: Monitor phenobarbital serum levels and seizure control; counsel patients on consistent turmeric dosing and report any changes in seizure frequency or barbiturate side effects.
